name: transfer_lift_holdout_v1
description: Held-out fictional benchmark for cross-domain strategy transfer. Each positive case is solvable from its own inputs, but the obvious shortcut answer is wrong, so completion moves only when the procedure carried by cross-family lesson records is followed. Negative-transfer and safety control cases carry only records the selector must reject.
